listing.summary: a purposefully overpowered system near the core worlds that should contain everything you need to create a thriving set of colonies to do whatever you want with
listing.aiSummary: Adds a purposefully overpowered star system near the core worlds containing resources for colony development.

description: Introduces a single star system located near the core worlds that is designed to be extremely powerful. It contains all necessary elements to establish thriving colonies, allowing players to pursue various strategies. The mod's files are simple text-based configurations, making it easy for users to manually edit planet details if desired.
